SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date December 5, 1933.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. S. B. REGI No. D）

Subject (in full) Antecedents of Russian female dance ticket vendor named Anna
Spiridonovna Stepanova alias Stepennova.
Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by O.9 [签名]

In connection with the attached inquiry concerning the
antecedents of a Russian woman employed as a seller of dance
tickets at the Cha Loh Dance Hall in Thibet Road, the undersigned
paid a visit to this particular cabaret and got into conversation
with a ticket seller whose description is as follows :
A woman aged about 35 to 40 years, average height, rather
corpulent, fair hair, good regular teeth. She informed me that
she had been employed in her present capacity for about seven
months and that she was previously engaged at the New Royal
Cabaret in the French Concession.
This information was passed to D.S. Tcheremshansky who was
able to ascertain that the woman in question is named Anna
Spiridonovna Stepanova alias Stepennova. She was born at
Blagoveschensk, Siberia in 1891 and first came to Shanghai from
Vladivostock in 1920. Since 1928 she has been employed as a
dance hostess and ticket vendor in various cabarets of the poorer
class, as for example, the New Royal, Blue Rose etc. in Rue Chu
Pan San, French Concession. During this period she has resided
at as many as twelve different addresses. Twice during 1932 she
visited Chefoo. In the Boarding House Register she describes
herself as an artist. Mrs Stepanova is a widow; the person whose
record is given hereunder is reported to be her son :
Victor Vassilievitch Stepanoff alias Stepeoff, born March 23,
1910 at Habarovsk; came to Shanghai in 1920, since which date he
has been employed for varying periods of time at the Canidrome,
Capitol, Holliwood and Majestic Cinemas, Luna Park etc. From
August 1932 until the date of his dismissal for being generally
unsatisfactory on January 21, 1933, he had a position as Bus
Inspector with the China General Omnibus Company. He is now a

主题（全称） 名为 Anna Spiridonovna Stepanova 或称 Stepennova 的俄罗斯籍女舞票售卖员的背景情况。
制作人 D.S. Jones 转呈人 O.9 [签名]

就附函关于在西藏路查乐（Cha Loh）舞厅受雇为舞票售卖员的一名俄罗斯妇女的背景调查事宜，具名人走访了该特定歌舞厅，并与一名舞票售卖员进行了交谈，其体貌特征如下：
女性，年龄约35至40岁，中等身材，较为肥胖，金发，牙齿整齐良好。她告知我，她以目前身份受雇约七个月，此前曾在法租界的新皇家（New Royal）歌舞厅任职。
此信息已转告 D.S. Tcheremshansky，他得以查明该女子名为 Anna Spiridonovna Stepanova，或称 Stepennova。她于1891年出生于西伯利亚布拉戈维申斯克（Blagoveschensk），并于1920年首次从符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）来到上海。自1928年以来，她一直在各类较低档次的歌舞厅担任舞女和舞票售卖员，例如法租界朱葆三街（Rue Chu Pan San）的新皇家、蓝玫瑰（Blue Rose）等。在此期间，她曾居住在多达十二个不同的地址。1932年间，她曾两次前往芝罘（Chefoo）。在寄宿舍登记簿中，她自称是艺术家。Stepanova 夫人为寡妇；据报以下记录之人为其子：
Victor Vassilievitch Stepanoff，或称 Stepeoff，1910年3月23日出生于哈巴罗夫斯克（Habarovsk）；1920年来到上海，自那时起，他在卡尼德罗姆（Canidrome）、首都（Capitol）、好莱坞（Holliwood）和大光明（Majestic）电影院、 luna park 等地断续受雇。从1932年8月至1933年1月21日因总体表现不佳被解雇之日止，他在中国公共汽车公司（China General Omnibus Company）担任巴士稽查员。他现在是

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D______
Date ____ / ____ / ____

SPL. INQUIRY Special Branch,
November 26, 1933.

S.2

Please trace the history and present
affiliations of a Russian woman who sells dance
tickets at the Cha Loh Dancing Hall in Thibet
Road which is frequented by Foreign troops.

The Cha Loh Dancing Hall was put out of
bounds for British troops about three months
ago, but the ban was lifted this month. The
place is managed by an ex-member of the U.S.
Marine Corps named Scheivner.

Decisions about putting places out of
bounds are made by Captain Fenton who usually
acts on the recommendation of Lieutenant
R.B. Moss, D.A.P.M. The latter depends for
information on Sergeant Major Lawrence, R.F.B.,
who has been here since last February.

Lieut. Moss lives in the Great Western Road
Mess, and his telephone number is Force 43.

The inquiry should be conducted very
confidentially and nothing should be said to
any of the military people named without consulting
me.

〔签名〕
O.i/c Sp.Br.

D. S. Jones,
P.S. Tcheoumshansky will
assist you in this enquiry.
〔签名〕
24/11

编号 D______
日期 ____ / ____ / ____

特别调查 特别处，
1933年11月26日。

S.2

请追查一名在西藏路查乐（Cha Loh）舞厅售卖舞票的俄罗斯妇女的历史及当前社会关系，该舞厅常有外国军队人员光顾。

查乐舞厅大约在三个月前被禁止英军进入，但本月已解除禁令。该场所由一名前美国海军陆战队成员 Scheivner 管理。

关于禁止进入某场所的决定由 Fenton 上尉作出，他通常依据副助理副军务长（D.A.P.M.）R.B. Moss 中尉的建议行事。后者依赖的情报来源是 R.F.B. 的军士长 Lawrence，他自去年二月起便在此地。

Moss 中尉住在静安寺路（Great Western Road）军官食堂，他的电话号码是 Force 43。

此项调查应极其保密地进行，在未与我协商的情况下，不得向任何上述军方人员透露只言片语。

〔签名〕
特别处主管警官。

D. S. Jones，
P.S. Tcheoumshansky 将
协助你进行此项调查。
〔签名〕
11月24日
